app.name: DesaKita
app.tagline: Community-run tourism villages, easy to find and book.
home.heading: Discover tourism villages run by local communities
home.lead: Compare activity packages, see which dates are available, and send a booking request straight to the village managers.

village.banner.suspended: The admin has temporarily suspended this village, so travelers can't see it. Contact the admin for more information.

village.new.explain: Fill in the basic details. The admin verifies the village before travelers can see it.
village.field.name: Tourism village name
village.field.description_hint: Tell travelers what makes the village special, what residents do, and how to get there.
village.preview: Preview: travelers can't see this village yet.

package.preview: Preview: travelers can't see this package yet.

package.field.description_hint: Describe the schedule, what is included, and what to bring.
package.field.quota_hint: The quota is the maximum number of people per departure date. You can change it for specific dates in the calendar.
photo.field.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB. Location data in the photo is removed automatically.
photo.field.consent: I confirm this photo may be published: the village managers and the residents shown have given their consent.
photo.limit: You have reached the photo limit. Delete an old photo to add a new one.
photo.consent_required: Tick the consent statement before uploading.
upload.too_large: The photo is larger than 5 MB.

upload.corrupt: The photo file is damaged or unreadable.
validation.price: Enter the price in rupiah, for example 150000.
flash.village_created: Village registered. It is awaiting admin verification.
flash.package_created: Package created. Add photos to make it more appealing.
flash.package_deactivated: Package deactivated; travelers can't see it.
error.too_large.title: Too much data
error.too_large.message: The file or form you sent is over the size limit. Photos can be at most 5 MB.
validation.party_size: Number of people must be 1 to 1000.
package.preview_no_booking: Booking opens once the village is verified and the package is active.
booking.field.note_hint: For example: small children, food allergies, or arrival time.
booking.new.title: Send a booking request
booking.new.explain: Choose a departure date between %s and %s. The village managers will confirm your request.
booking.new.payment_note: There is no online payment. The village managers will contact you to confirm and arrange payment.
booking.new.login_required: Log in or create an account to send a booking request.
booking.error.date_window: Choose a date that is available in the calendar.
booking.error.date_closed: The managers have closed this date. Choose another date.
booking.error.sold_out: There isn't enough quota left on this date for that many people. Choose another date or fewer people.
booking.error.pending_limit: You already have 3 requests awaiting confirmation. Wait for the managers to respond or cancel one of them.
booking.error.invalid_transition: The booking status has changed. Please check the details again.
booking.error.note_too_long: The message is too long (at most 500 characters).
booking.error.quota_below_reserved: The quota can't be lower than the number of people already booked.
booking.mine.title: My bookings
booking.mine.empty: You don't have any bookings yet.
booking.mine.pending_explain: Awaiting the managers' confirmation. If there is no response by %s, the request expires automatically.
booking.mine.confirmed_explain: Your booking is confirmed. The managers will contact you about payment and arrival details.
booking.mine.expired_explain: The managers didn't respond in time. Please send a new request or contact the village.
booking.detail.title: Booking #%d
booking.cancel.heading: Cancel booking
booking.wa.traveler: Hello %[2]s, this is %[1]s. I'd like to ask about booking #%[7]d for the %[3]s package on %[4]s (%[5]d people).
booking.wa.pending: Hello %[1]s, this is %[2]s. We have received booking request #%[7]d for the %[3]s package on %[4]s (%[5]d people) and are reviewing it.
booking.wa.confirmed: Hello %[1]s, this is %[2]s. Booking #%[7]d for the %[3]s package on %[4]s (%[5]d people) is CONFIRMED. Estimated total %[6]s. We will send payment and arrival details. Thank you!
booking.wa.rejected: Hello %[1]s, this is %[2]s. We're sorry, we can't accept booking request #%[7]d for the %[3]s package on %[4]s.
booking.wa.cancelled: Hello %[1]s, this is %[2]s. Booking #%[7]d for the %[3]s package on %[4]s has been cancelled.
booking.wa.expired: Hello %[1]s, this is %[2]s. We're sorry, we missed booking request #%[7]d for the %[3]s package on %[4]s. Are you still interested?
booking.wa.completed: Hello %[1]s, thank you for visiting %[2]s for the %[3]s package. We hope you enjoyed it and see you again!
manage.bookings.title: Bookings
manage.booking.respond_by: Respond before %s. After that the request expires automatically and the quota is released.
manage.calendar.title: Calendar
manage.calendar.explain: Tap a date to change its quota or close it. The numbers show people booked out of the quota.
manage.calendar.close_hint: Closing a date only stops new bookings. Existing bookings are not cancelled.
flash.booking_sent: Booking request sent. The village managers will respond soon.
flash.booking_confirmed: Booking confirmed. Don't forget to let the traveler know.
search.empty: No matching packages. Try changing or clearing the filters.
search.no_packages_yet: No packages available yet. Partner villages are getting ready.
report.reason: What is the problem? (for example false information or a scam)
report.error.reason: Describe the reason for the report (at most 1000 characters).
admin.title: Admin
admin.suspend_hint: The village disappears from the catalogue and gets no new bookings. Existing bookings are not cancelled; contact the managers.
admin.reason: Reason (required when rejecting, visible to the managers)
admin.error.status_changed: The village status has changed. Reload the page.
admin.error.reason_required: A reason is required (at most 1000 characters).
flash.report_sent: Thank you. An admin will review your report.
flash.village_verified: Village verified; travelers can now see it.
error.rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
error.rate_limited.message: You are trying too often. Wait a moment and try again.
photo.field.caption: Photo caption (optional)
photo.field.caption_hint: Describe the photo for screen readers, for example "Residents planting rice on terraced fields". If empty, the village or package name is used.
photo.caption_too_long: Captions can be at most 200 characters.
footer.sdg_heading: Aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)
footer.sdg8: SDG 8 — Decent work and economic growth
home.how.title: How booking works
home.how.find_text: Compare activities, prices and durations from verified villages.
home.how.request_text: Choose an available date and the number of people. There is no online payment.
home.how.confirm_text: The village managers confirm and contact you, usually on WhatsApp.
search.more_filters: Filter by area, activity and price
package.how.title: How to book this package
package.how.step1: Choose an available departure date (at the earliest, the day after tomorrow).
package.how.step2: Enter the number of people and your contact details, then send the request.
package.how.step3: The village managers confirm within 48 hours and contact you about payment.
package.no_payment_now: Nothing to pay now. You pay the village managers directly after confirmation.
booking.steps.label: Booking steps
village.verified_note: This village has been verified by the DesaKita admin. Booking and payment are arranged directly with the village managers.
guide.title: Quick guide for managers
guide.step1.title: Complete the village profile
guide.step1.text: Add a description, the address and an active WhatsApp number so travelers can reach you easily.
guide.step2.title: Upload photos with consent
guide.step2.text: Choose bright photos, write a short caption, and make sure the residents shown have agreed.
guide.step3.title: Create packages and set the calendar
guide.step3.text: Set the price per person and the daily quota. Close dates when the village has an event.
guide.step4.title: Respond to requests
guide.step4.text: Confirm or reject within 48 hours, then press "Let them know on WhatsApp" to tell the traveler.
guide.help: Need help? Contact the DesaKita admin through the contact on this page, or ask another manager in your village for support.
admin.nav.label: Admin menu
admin.queue.title: Verification queue
admin.recent.title: Recent activity
admin.village.open_reports: %d open reports about this village or its packages
admin.village.open_reports.one: %d open report about this village or its packages
admin.village.audited: Every action is recorded in the audit log with the admin's name and the time.
admin.error.note_too_long: Notes can be at most 1000 characters.
admin.audit.explain: A permanent record of every admin action. Entries can't be changed or deleted.
search.syntax_hint: Tip: use "quotes" for a phrase, or -word to exclude a word.
review.none_yet: No reviews yet. Only travelers who have visited can write a review.
review.cta_text: How was your visit? Reviews help other travelers and the village.
review.form.title: Review your visit
review.form.body_hint: What stood out? What could be better?
review.form.public_note: Your review appears on the package page with your first name and initial. 10 to 2000 characters.
review.only_completed: You can write a review once the managers mark your visit as completed.
review.error.rating: Choose a rating of 1 to 5 stars.
review.error.not_eligible: A review can't be sent for this booking (not completed yet, or already reviewed).
flash.review_published: Thank you! Your review is now published.
admin.reviews.explain: Reviews are published immediately because they can only be written after a completed visit. Hide reviews that break the rules; every action is recorded in the audit log.
admin.reviews.hide_reason: Reason for hiding (required, visible to the author)
map.title: Tourism village map
map.intro: Every verified tourism village that has added its location. Choose a marker to see the village name, then open its page.
map.empty: No verified village has added its location yet.
map.picker_label: Map for choosing the village location
village.field.location_hint: Click the map or drag the marker to fill in the coordinates. You can also type the latitude and longitude, for example from a map app on your phone.
validation.location_pair: Fill in both latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
validation.location_number: Coordinates must be decimal numbers, for example -7.797068.
stats.title: Statistics
stats.hint: Requests, visitors and estimated village revenue.
stats.revenue_hint: Based on prices at booking time; the village receives payment directly.
stats.chart_empty: No completed visits in the last 12 months.
stats.note: Requests are counted by the date they arrived. Visits, visitors and revenue are counted by the departure date of bookings marked as completed. Bookings cancelled after confirmation still count as accepted.
stats.chart_compact_note: Showing the last 6 months. Open the table to see all 12.
footer.note: Payment always goes directly to the village managers.
auth.login.lead: Log in to book tour packages or manage your village.
auth.register.lead: Free. Book village tour packages or register your village.
home.trust.title: Why book with DesaKita
home.trust.verified_text: Every village is checked by an admin before it appears.
home.trust.direct_text: No online payment; the money reaches the community.
home.trust.quota_text: See the places left before you send a request.
